g.text: Secrets excluded from Git and NEXT_PUBLIC_*.
Browser: localhost:3100 / separate DB, volume and env
Only Web has public domain: brewlite-production.up.railway.app.
API and DB use private network; hostnames/digests are listed in DEPLOYMENT.md and CD evidence.
BFF belongs to Next.js; Prisma and mock payment belong to NestJS.
Migration is temporary execution, not a fourth permanent service.
CI script does not change scaling; high availability is not claimed.
DB restart / live rollback / PWA HTTPS install and full AC sign-off remain unverified.
Old Postgres 18 is outside target topology; not deleted.
